messages:
Avery (People Ops): Quick heads-up — new hire & backfill for Inference lead role. Raul Kim is joining Redwood as Senior Inference Engineer (Team Lead) starting Mon Apr 13. He'll be reporting to Cheng Li. :tada:

Avery (People Ops): Short summary: Raul comes from Nebula AI (inference runtime/perf). He'll own the inference runtime roadmap items, coordinate across eng-platform, eng-infra, eng-ml, and take over the inference oncall rotation.

Cheng Li: Welcome Raul! I'll post a 30/60/90 ramp plan and set weekly 1:1s. Please add him to #inference and the inference-runner repo.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Adding him to oncall and infra groups today. If anyone needs him on specific weeks (1-4), ping me.

Marie (Eng-ML): I'll set up a model-ops onboarding walkthrough and share our playbook + dashboards. Raul — what timezone are you in? I can do async notes if needed.

Raul Kim: Hi all — excited to join. I'm PST-based, prefer mornings. Happy to take the Apr 15 arch sync if that's useful.

Noah (People Ops): Laptop order placed (Dell XPS + 1TB NVMe). IT will reach out for VPN and workstation access. Slack + email already provisioned.

Tia (Recruiter): Offer paperwork & Greenhouse IDs are in GH if anyone needs them. Thanks for the smooth handoff.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Invited to inference-runner team on GitHub and added to oncall rota.

Cheng Li: Quick ask — try to avoid major runtime/infra rollouts the week of Apr 13 to keep noise low for Raul's first week. Urgent fixes still go through as usual.

Alex (Eng-Platform): Noted. We'll postpone the kernel swap planned Apr 14. Marking as postponed in the infra calendar.

Noah (People Ops): Scheduling a 30m "Welcome & Admin" session on his first day for benefits, security training, and badging. Invite sent.

Marie (Eng-ML): Shared onboarding checklist (DM) — short version:
```
- model-runner walkthrough
- eval/regression alerts tour
- perf dashboards access
- reproducible prompts repo
```

Raul Kim: Thanks — I'll review and ping Marie for times.

Cheng Li: I'll do a 1:1 on day 2 to review roadmap and active incidents. Temporarily reassigning a couple of Priya's projects; will post owners in the team doc.

Avery (People Ops): Managers — please book a 20-30m group welcome slot in week 1 if you haven't yet. We're planning a company-wide intro on Fri Apr 17 (short blurb + Q&A). I'll prepare announcement copy.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Blocking 15m ops sync on the calendar.

Hirebot: New hire profile published to /handbook/new-hires and pinned in #new-hires.

Noah (People Ops): If anyone needs extra hardware (GPU dongle / lab access), add requests to #eng-infra ticket and cc me so procurement can prioritize.

Cheng Li: Thanks everyone — excited to have Raul aboard. I'll update the Inference roadmap and owners list.

Avery (People Ops): Small ask: if you meet Raul in week 1, add a one-line note to the onboarding doc about the interaction (helps run-rate onboarding). I'll send the company-wide intro Friday morning.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Will do. Welcome, Raul! :wave:

Raul Kim: Appreciate it — looking forward to getting started.
